productionConditions: Original frozen sources vs the same sources with only Personal reply-style and clarification/migration changes; fresh production-default profiles, clean isolated history, candidate thinking off
officialRegression: Same 150 FollowBench items and 12 predetermined EQ scenarios as the original baseline; original upstream scores retained
focusedRegression: All 30 fixed Chinese scripts in p0-dialogues.json; one capture per condition; identical user scripts, generated assistant history, no persona simulator
focusedStatus: Diagnostic regression authored from the failure analysis; not an independent holdout or representative population estimate
blindJudging: Judge all 30 scripted pairs, all 12 EQ visible-dialogue pairs and FollowBench S11-L5. Two calls per pair, reversing presentation order. Score only visible text and public context; no hidden persona thoughts or official prior scores exposed.
violationUnit: Unique assistant reply per dimension; evidence and turn required. Report whole-dialogue prevalence and affected turns, with denominators. Dimensions can overlap; no scalar error sum.
pairOutcome: Each call returns left/right/tie. Agreeing calls determine stable winner, otherwise discordant; no cherry-picking or discretionary tiebreak calls. Report stable wins/ties/losses and discordant separately.
desiredGate: At least 60% weighted pair preference on the 24 focused behavior scripts (stable win=1, stable tie=0.5, stable loss=0, discordant=0.5), fewer affected conversations for all three P0 behavior dimensions, and no new major required-content/authorization regression in controls. Descriptive single-run gate, not a statistical significance claim.
scopeLimit: One repetition and one judge model. Swapped-order judgments are correlated, not independent judges. Full EQ trajectories can diverge; paired comparison is descriptive, not same-prefix causal proof. Do not tune prompts or choose reruns based on these results. Freeze source and fixture hashes before capture.
